comparison.objective: Install and secure a rack rail; record closes an astragal double-door enclosure and operates its bolt/latch in enforced order.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-point spring-prong insertion, telescoping, and screw fastening versus coordinating two door leaves, contact-enforced closure order, bolt throw, and quarter-turn cam latching.
comparison.success_condition: Level rail retained at four post holes with correct screws versus both leaves closed and secured by the bolt/latch.
comparison.reason: Latch use is generic; door sequencing does not test rail registration or load-bearing attachment.
